feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: NPR world news, international art and culture, world business and financial markets, world economy, and global trends in health, science and technology. Subscribe to the World Story of the Day podcast and RSS feed.

entry.title: Seafarer's union official says crews offered big money to transit Strait of Hormuz
entry.summary: As attacks continue to mount on shipping vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz, a seafarer's union official says some crews are being offered big rewards for making the crossing.

entry.title: Harrowing accounts of violence and sex abuse in women's prison told in new podcast
entry.summary: Madi Bolanos and Anna Sussman's new podcast We Are Jane Doe, by KQED and Snap Studios, investigates rampant sex abuse at the Central California Women's Facility in Chowchilla, Ca.

entry.title: Ukrainian MP calls U.S.-Russia diesel deal a 'betrayal'
entry.summary: NPR's Joel Rose speaks with Ukrainian Minister of Parliament, Oleksandr Merezhko, about the U.S.'s diesel deal with Russia will impact Ukraine.

entry.title: Pope Leo XIV to undergo lung surgery this week
entry.summary: Pope Leo XIV said he would undergo surgery after doctors found a "localized nodule" in his lung.

entry.title: She was a global star: Teen bikes 700 miles carrying injured dad. Where is she now?
entry.summary: Her epic ride — carrying her injured dad on her $20 hot pink bicycle — made headlines. Promises were made — financial help, training for a cycling career, even a movie deal. Were any of them kept?

entry.title: Saudi airport passenger terminal is struck again, a day after 12 were killed
entry.summary: A projectile struck a passenger terminal at the international airport in Riyadh on Sunday, a day after a missile hit the same terminal and killed 12 people, officials said.

entry.title: Bayeux Tapestry's London tour spurs enthusiasts to Battle of Hastings reenactment
entry.summary: A reenactment of the Battle of Hastings, which took place almost a millennium ago, is drawing crowds of enthusiasts in the UK.

entry.title: Trump weighs joining the fight against Houthis after Riyadh airport attack
entry.summary: The surge in attacks, including against other Saudi airports, military facilities and oil infrastructure, has come in the week since a Saudi-led coalition launched a major military offensive against the Houthis.

entry.title: Protests against voter roll revisions rock capital of world's largest democracy
entry.summary: Parts of the capital city of India, the world's largest democracy, are on lockdown. Protests over sweeping revisions to the voter rolls were met with a massive police crackdown.

entry.title: U.S. and Russia tout diesel deal to ease sanctions and reopen fuel flows
entry.summary: Moscow and Washington tout a diesel deal to ease sanctions and reopen fuel flows, but few details leave questions on price impacts and U.S. policy, sparking anger from Ukraine and allies.
